descFull: Local RAG server for Claude Code, Cursor and other MCP clients: hybrid BM25 + vector search with cross-encoder reranking on by default, 13 MCP tools, 33 file types including code, re-indexing on file changes. One Python process with embedded ChromaDB and FastEmbed ONNX: no Docker, database server or API key; offline after the first model download.
